title: Tanzania's Coast Beyond Zanzibar: Pangani and Ushongo
excerpt: Pangani and Ushongo on the mainland coast offer quiet beaches, history and dhow trips, far from the crowds.
body:
## Pangani

A historic town at the mouth of the Pangani River, with old buildings and river trips.

## Ushongo

A quiet beach south of Pangani with small lodges.

## Maziwe Island

A sandbank marine reserve offshore, good for snorkelling at low tide.

## Getting there

By road from the Usambaras or Saadani, or by light aircraft.

## Combine

With [Saadani](/blog/saadani-bush-meets-beach/) and the [Usambara Mountains](/blog/usambara-mountains-lushoto/).

Read our [Pangani page](/national-parks/pangani/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
